Serve as a hands-on digital content leader who can establish the strategy and ensure execution meets a high standard. Data, Analytics & Continuous Optimization Establish and monitor KPIs for digital content and experiences in partnership with marketing, analytics, engagement, and business teams. Translate data and analytics into clear insights, recommendations, and prioritized actions. Develop and maintain reporting dashboards and recurring performance reporting that provide actionable visibility into digital performance. Accessibility, Governance & Best Practices Serve as a digital content accessibility lead and liaison, partnering with appropriate teams to ensure digital content and experiences meet accessibility standards and provide an inclusive experience for all users. Conduct and coordinate regular content audits, identifying opportunities to improve accessibility, usability, content quality, SEO, and overall digital experience. Develop documentation, governance, workflows, templates, and operating processes that make digital content work more efficient, scalable, and consistent. Additional duties may be assigned as the discretion of the Sr. Director, Digital Marketing.
